name: supply-knots-lp-v1
curve: Monotone cubic Hermite interpolation of six nodal prices; five independently learned positive increments and five shared local-clock midpoint coefficients per technology/bidding zone.
initializer: Resample the corresponding odd-month-only differentiable-spline-v1 fit at the six supply nodes; dominant source country's own-month parameter, selected using physical capacity only. No even-month targets or inherited annual price fit.
selection: Minimum sampled training joint smooth-clearing loss across initialization and eight Adam updates; freeze before any next-even-month scoring.
objective: Smooth price MAE/40 + sample-expanded normalized Ember monthly generation error with .25TWh floor + .001 mean squared displacement from neutral coefficients. Fixed reservoir uses exact monthly total; no invented hourly generation targets.
aggregation: Pool only identical-constraint technology columns within each bidding zone. Source-cost anchor is hourly availability-weighted. Country output attribution follows original source availability shares, not independently identified plant dispatch.
evaluation: Original HiGHS LP physical equations; 20 divisible equal-MW tranches priced by exact spline interval averages. Both learned and neutral controls, all4344 even-month hours. Economic LP has no quadratic regularizer; source artificial emergency must remain zero. Accepted annual model is in-sample context only.
scope: Conditional retrospective source/model validation. No baseline, public explorer or review change. Exact smooth fit and LP inference are different allocations; report their mismatch on training hours. All-hour even-month metrics are not a full-year score.
